facts.fact: 帝国军官走后，姐妹在巷中站了很久；Jingling 握住姐姐的手，Kiamling 把那只手拉近自己身体。
facts.anchor: The sisters stood in the alley for a long few moments after the imperial officer finally left. At some point Jingling had taken her sister’s hand, and Kiamling had pulled it close to her body.

facts.fact: Kiamling 想为 Por Por 的谎言发火（她屡次讲诚信，却瞒了孙女许多事）；Jingling 说人人都有秘密，这话带刺，扎进 Kiamling 的软肉。
facts.anchor: “She must have had her reasons,” Jingling said. “We all have our secrets.” The words were barbed, digging into Kiamling’s soft flesh to make their point.

facts.fact: 次日 Hoi 独自出门办事；姐妹给寄住处周围乞丐一些铜钱、买一大罐 mau toi 等候，不到一小时 So 就找上门。
facts.anchor: The sisters gave some coins to the beggars around the boarding house, then procured a large jar of mau toi and waited.

facts.fact: 他外表是邋遢老丐，实为广东十虎之一、有名的武者，也是 Kiamling 从前的师父之一。
facts.anchor: Beggar So nevertheless grinned as he rubbed the back of his head. Despite appearances, he was one of the Ten Tigers of Canton, a celebrated martial artist and one of Kiamling’s former instructors.

facts.fact: 他既是武师，也是丐帮帮主；丐帮居无定所、不蓄财物，却拥有本区最好的情报网——没人会多看街边乞丐一眼。
facts.anchor: As well as his martial prowess, he was also the head of the Beggar Clan, a group that lived an itinerant lifestyle without material possessions. They had one of the best spy networks in the region.

facts.fact: Kiamling 向他讲述祖母被影兽掳走、以及那道蓝光门；但她隐瞒了门事后一直开着这件事。
facts.anchor: He kept sipping as Kiamling told him about Por Por’s abduction by the shadow beast. About the doorway lined in blue, even if she omitted the details of it remaining open afterwards.

facts.fact: Jingling 比 Kiamling 先答出“太平军”：他们在村庄屠杀数千人，拒绝入伙者的血染红田野，怨气把两界屏障冲薄。
facts.anchor: “The Taiping rebels,” Jingling said, reaching the answer a moment before Kiamling. They had massacred thousands in the villages. The fields were awash with the blood of those who refused to join their fanatical cause.

facts.fact: So 说细节只有祖母知道；近六年前广州省开过一道门，geongsi 成群掠过乡野、吸食一切活物的气（官方称瘟疫掩盖，实为听命于人）。
facts.anchor: But I know one thing: here in Canton province, nearly six years ago, a doorway opened and a horde of geongsi swept through the countryside, sucking qi from anything that breathed.

facts.fact: So 难以置信祖母从未说过，直接揭出：姐妹俩的父母是太平军。
facts.anchor: “Did she honestly never tell you?” He looked first at Jingling, then at Kiamling, but both shook their heads. “Your parents were Taiping rebels.”

facts.fact: 他说太平军原只是愤怒的穷人；她父母如何卷入他不清楚，但广州全境对姐妹悬赏——香港因英军驻扎才安全，广州连十虎也保不住她们。
facts.anchor: Once they were just angry and poor, like the rest of us. Exactly how your parents were involved, I do not know. But in Canton, there’s a bounty on all your heads.” He saw the disbelief in their eyes.

facts.fact: So 掏出“wan yi”（浑仪）：六个以上互连环，天文学家与算学家用它追踪星辰、预测日食；他的小如掌心、环环相套。
facts.anchor: It was a wan yi. Kiamling had seen pictures of them in books, but never in real life. Six or more interconnected rings used by astronomers and mathematicians to track the movements of the stars and predict eclipses.

facts.fact: 它更精确地标出两界薄弱相接之处；So 拨外六环示范：八月十五夜（饿鬼节）两界相接。
facts.anchor: “More precisely, the points where the veil between the two thins.” Beggar So moved the outer six rings in demonstration. “Here is where they meet, on the fifteenth night of the eighth month. The Hungry Ghost Festival.”

facts.fact: Jingling 指出下一个窗口是“除夕”；只剩三个月，祖母要在西洋鬼怪的灵界撑过这三个月。
facts.anchor: “The eve of the new year.” Three months. Kiamling had only three months to prepare for the veil to thin, for Por Por to survive in a realm of Western ghosts and monsters.

facts.fact: 门被猛砸；Kiamling 天眼未闭，看见走廊楼梯上十几个人的身影，随即兵刃相击、一声左轮枪响。
facts.anchor: Her third eye still active, Kiamling could see the vivid flickering silhouettes of a dozen people in the hallway and stairs. The sound of a skirmish reached her ears, metal on metal and then a revolver shot.

facts.fact: So 与他们同上屋顶，杖指南方，命她们去港口搭蒸汽船；既然对方知道她们还活着，就不能再回广州。
facts.anchor: Beggar So came with them, pointed to the south with his staff. “Get on a steamship at the harbour. You cannot come back to Canton. Not now they know you are still alive.”

facts.fact: So 把 wan yi 塞进她手里，说这是她父亲的遗物。
facts.anchor: “Take this.” He pushed the wan yi into her hands. “It belonged to your father.”

facts.fact: Jingling 起身时脚踝似乎扭伤；蒸汽船虽不远却不知有何埋伏，Kiamling 掂量后蹲下背起妹妹。
facts.anchor: Jingling struggled to her feet, but her ankle looked to be twisted. Shit. They weren’t far from the steamships, but who could say what was waiting for them when they got there.

facts.fact: 气池耗尽之际，Kiamling 感到气如泉水灌入——是 Jingling 隔空把自己的气渡给她；她借力踏水奔到船边。
facts.anchor: Before the horror of the situation could sink in, she felt qi pouring into her like someone with a jug of spring water. It was Jingling. Somehow her sister was channelling her own qi across to her.

facts.fact: Kiamling 决定不说破：一旦让人知道 Jingling 会用气，妹妹就会被拖入危险、成为被放逐者；她只默默搂住妹妹的肩。
facts.anchor: If she let on that Jingling could use her qi… well, she might be pulled into this. Into further danger. Into the life of an outcast. Kiamling said nothing, putting her arm around Jingling’s shoulder instead.

facts.fact: 喘匀气才发现上的不是蒸汽船，而是一条迟缓离岸的小帆船；她怒道这样不够快、会被追上。
facts.anchor: Only as she caught her breath did she realise they were not aboard a steamship after all. It was a small junk, moving sluggishly away from land.

facts.fact: Jingling 谢 Hoi 弄到船、问他怎知要逃；Hoi 只答“一个乞丐拦住我”，随即调帆，船借风骤然加速。
facts.anchor: “A beggar accosted me.” Hoi moved across the deck to adjust the fan-like sails. They caught the wind, filling as the ship suddenly picked up speed.

facts.fact: 她们在城中一直被监视；北京想用她们当间谍，另一些人只要她们死；她宁可回香港对付怪物，也不留广州对付人——一如往常，她们只能靠自己。
facts.anchor: They had been watched throughout their brief time in the city. Peking wanted them to be spies; others just wanted them dead.
